answer: Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. Copying an answer hence yields nothing, and producing 107 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the mirror ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the ridge review can re-run it. A near-duplicate is rejected at the river gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
